# Start plan reviewer

This skill is the **command**. You are the parent. Immediately delegate to the **crav1-plan-reviewer-agent** subagent. Load `.agents/skills/crav1-docs/agents/crav1-plan-reviewer-agent.md` (drop-in) or this plugin’s `agents/crav1-plan-reviewer-agent.md`. Do not review in your own voice as a substitute. Do not edit files, except the one `Reviewed:` line in **Record the review** below. Do not write application code. Do not resolve product questions (those belong on the spec).

## Find the spec folder

Use the folder the user @-mentions. Otherwise the most recently edited tree under `docs/specs/` excluding `_template/`. If several, ask which slug, then delegate.

Need `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`. If plan/tasks are missing, stop (`$crav1-plan-from-spec`). Do not invent a plan in this command.

Pass the subagent these paths (read-only): `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, plus `diagrams.md` / `adr/` if present. Also point it at this skill’s `assets/` (drop-in also `.agents/skills/crav1-docs/agent-assets/crav1-plan-reviewer-agent/`; plugin also `agent-assets/crav1-plan-reviewer-agent/`) for **expected plan/tasks shape**, not as the files under review. Run the subagent in the foreground. When a review packet exists (the spec walk writes one before the review), pass its path too; the subagent never reads `spec.md` whole (1.197.0).

## What to tell the subagent

Instruct it to follow its own prompt and the check rules in `crav1-plan-from-spec` [references/checks.md](../crav1-plan-from-spec/references/checks.md) (skill `crav1-plan-from-spec`, `references/checks.md`), including **Linter, before Build**. A stale research finding that the plan left out of Risks is a plan issue. Stale research does not block the plan. A plan that never says whether this repo has a linter or checker for the code the tasks will touch is not complete. Finish with numbered **Issues for `$crav1-tighten-plan`** (`P1`, `P2`, …), one finding each. Mark any finding that is really a spec defect as **spec** (do not pretend the plan can fix it). No single global patch recommendation.

## Record the review

After the subagent returns, save its reply to a file and run `<interpreter> -X utf8 ../crav1-plan-from-spec/scripts/plan_check.py open-count --review <file> --vendor codex`. Pick the interpreter as `crav1-docs/reference/running-scripts.md` says. `<n>` is that command's `open` value (0 when the reply lists no `P#`). Use that value. Do not count the `P#` lines yourself. Write one line in `plan.md`, right under the `# Plan:` title: `Reviewed: <today's date>, P# open: <n>`. Replace an earlier `Reviewed:` line, and the template's comment about it, instead of adding a second line. Change nothing else in `plan.md` or `tasks.md`. Say in the recap that the line was written and quote the script's `open` value. `$crav1-tasks-ready-to-build` reads it. This skill does not commit.

## After it returns

Show the subagent’s review. Then Run next, with the label "Walk the plan findings, which aren't walked yet:" on its own line above `` `$crav1-tighten-plan <slug>` ``. Spec-tagged findings stay in the review. Do not name them as a second step. Do not start tighten in this turn unless they already asked.

When `## Linter` says this repo has no linter or checker for the code the tasks will touch, do not name Build (`$crav1-build-tasks`, `$crav1-build-features`). Stop before Build. The user decides to add the linter or to go on without one. Do not install one. A plan that already says none is complete on that point. Do not file a `P#` only because the answer is none.

Do not run `$crav1-review-pr`. Specify does not name the linter.

## Run ending (1.122.0)

End as [run-ending.md](../crav1-docs/reference/run-ending.md) says.
